name: destiny-atlas
description: Explore BaZi, Zi Wei, natal charts, tarot, I Ching and numerology for cultural entertainment and self-reflection.

interface.longDescription: Explore Chinese BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu charts, Western natal charts, numerology, Chinese name analysis, compatibility, zodiac readings, tarot, oracle cards, I Ching and astrology dice. Find birthplace coordinates and time zones to support chart calculations. Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Cantonese. Destiny Atlas is intended for cultural entertainment and self-reflection; readings are not factual predictions or professional advice. No Destiny Atlas login is required. This integration does not access saved account history, manage subscriptions or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a BaZi chart.
Draw a tarot card for self-reflection.
Cast an I Ching hexagram for me.

positive.prompt: Find Hong Kong birthplace coordinates and its time zone.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching cities and their coordinates and IANA time zones; distinguish ambiguous matches.

positive.prompt: For a fictional example, calculate a BaZi chart for a woman born on May 15, 1990 at 10:00 in Hong Kong, Gregorian calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the calculated Four Pillars and cultural interpretation; explain that this is entertainment and self-reflection.

positive.prompt: Draw one tarot card for general self-reflection in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one randomly drawn card and a reflective interpretation without claiming a guaranteed prediction.

positive.prompt: Cast an I Ching hexagram using coin mode for general self-reflection in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the generated hexagram and cultural interpretation, without presenting it as a factual forecast.

positive.prompt: For a fictional birthday of May 15, 1990, calculate life path numerology in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Return numerology results derived from the supplied sample date and frame interpretations as cultural entertainment.

negative.prompt: Use Destiny Atlas to charge my credit card and buy a subscription.
Retrieve another user’s saved Destiny Atlas birth charts.
Use tarot to decide whether I should stop taking prescribed medication.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools do not process payments, purchase subscriptions or access paid account history. The separate Destiny Atlas website offers subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission using the live, unauthenticated Streamable HTTP endpoint and 12 Destiny Atlas tools.
